description: Resolving VLBI correlator ambiguity in the time delay model improves precision of geodetic measurements is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. The modern Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) relativistic delay model, as documented in the IERS Conventions, refers to the time epoch when the signal passes one of two stations of an interferometer baseline (selected arbitrarily from the pair of stations and called the ‘reference station’ or ‘station 1’). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are EARTH SCIENCES, Geodesy, IVS, Lorentz transformation, Published_External. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
